about: THE VAULT LOBBY look test (docs/survivorz/ASSETS.md step C): what stands where, in world metres (x east, y up, z south; the map's own coordinates). Read by scripts/survivorz/room-build.py (the bake puts each prop's geometry in, so its shadows are in the lightmap) and by client/src/survivorz/room/ (which places the packed props). yaw: degrees about +Y, three's rotation.y. A prop's origin is the middle of its footprint, its bottom at y 0 (pack-props.mjs).
